name: baseline
title: Four-engine baseline
description: Protected Mesh and the stock Oban, River and Apalis workers. Each engine uses its original producer and default PostgreSQL storage.

name: current
title: Protected Mesh rebuild
description: Current and archived protected Mesh releases alongside stock River and Oban.

name: lean
title: Protected worker and admission
description: Four Mesh builds isolate the smaller fresh-exec worker, set-based claims, and the two changes together. Every job retains a fresh process and two fenced application commits.

name: direct
title: Direct-file producer
description: The compiled Mesh producer reads and decodes the input file after submission. Two stock Mesh controls use the original broker. PostgreSQL uses its default storage for all four engines.

name: storage
title: Large payloads · Mesh storage tuning
description: The two tuned Mesh arms use PostgreSQL EXTERNAL storage for job arguments. The three peers use their default storage. Repeated-character payloads can use substantially more disk with EXTERNAL.

name: symmetric
title: Large payloads · equal storage tuning
description: Every engine stores the full 512 KiB payload with PostgreSQL EXTERNAL storage. Both protected Mesh arms process the same jobs with different producers.

name: ordinary
title: Trusted shared-process handlers
description: Ordinary Mesh handlers share a process and credentials and use application-owned PostgreSQL connections. Protected Mesh uses a fresh process and token-fenced writes. All four engines commit both writes independently.
